sloka: स लब्धसञ्ज्ञो बलवान् मुष्टिमावर्त्त्य राक्षसः।अपहासेन चिक्षेप विसञ्ज्ञः स पपात ह ।। ६.६७.५० ।।
transliteration: sa labdhasañjño balavān muṣṭimāvarttya rākṣasaḥ।apahāsena cikṣepa visañjñaḥ sa papāta ha ।। 6.67.50 ।।

translations.english: Jumping up that way, Angada slapped him with his palm on the chest in anger. By that the mountain like Kumbhakarna became unconscious.
